ops.title: Deployment bridge/stop worker requests must carry Dir — cold package-install wedge (fixed v12.20.4)
ops.body: v12.20.0-12.20.3 built worker.CommandRequest for the deployment bridge ping and the application-stop command without Dir; daemonkit worker.copyAndValidate (worker/pool.go:707) rejects a non-exact Dir, so every readiness probe failed and package-install always hit the 20s readiness deadline and rolled back (two timing-dependent faces: the Dir rejection, or load-reaper-records deadline when the window expired mid-recovery). Cold installs and 12.19.x->12.20.x upgrades wedged on every machine; the release formula-application guard did not catch it because it exercised a machine with a prior generation. Fixed in 506fa0d by setting Dir=filepath.Dir(executable) on both requests. Diagnosis chronology + trust-verifier red herring (old host verifier pool closed -> generic PeerUntrusted) in the codex run codex-ask.1516173350.
